DISTRIBUTION. — The lowest occurrence of typical Sphenolithus spiniger (as defined below) is in the lower part of the Brussel Sand Formation (at Mont-des-Récollets in Unit B 2). It is known from many outcrop and borehole sections of the Brussel Sand Formation and increases in numbers during the Sphenolithus bloom, as recorded in the Diegem and Zaventem outcrop sections (Steurbaut, detailed in forthcoming study). It occurs rarely in the Lede Sand Formation.
